script: 1984, Tampa, Florida. A predator is hunting, and police have no leads. His name: Bobby Joe Long. He targets women alone at night, kidnaps them, and leaves no trace. The case goes cold until one survivor changes everything. Lisa McVey, just seventeen, is abducted, but she starts memorizing every detail. She counts turns, notices sounds, remembers a red carpet fiber in his car. That fiber becomes the key. FBI forensics match it to Long's car, and to ten murder scenes. Bobby Joe Long is convicted and sentenced to death. One survivor's memory ended a killer's reign.
